svg.title: Actual image patches and measured tracking error
svg.desc: Top: CC0 real photo crop with synthetic known warp and 12 actual detected features. Bottom: synthetic frame2 left, truth and tracked points in same pixel model. Intensities0..1, coordinates pixels; y increases down.

g.text: Real texture, artificial shift: actual pixels and detected patches
Patch IDs are the same detections; no real independent time pair is claimed.
12 accepted; error range 0.0217–0.0674 px. Image display scale: 2 screen px / image px.
